name: v1.6.1
body:
superfile v1.6.1 adds native trash support across Linux, macOS, and Windows, multi-file selection for the file picker, and directory item counts. It also fixes symlink copying, ZIP names for hidden files, and several shortcuts that acted on the wrong panel.

## Install

[**How to install superfile**](https://github.com/yorukot/superfile?tab=readme-ov-file#installation)

## Highlights

- Press `ctrl+d` to send files to the system trash. On Linux, files on other mounted drives can now use the trash on that drive. Thanks @yorukot and @paczek654321.
- Pick several files for a script with `--chooser-file`. Press `v`, mark the items with `enter`, then press `e` to write their paths in panel order. Thanks @Abhirup0.
- The size column now shows how many items a folder contains. To see its total size, press `m` to focus the metadata panel. Thanks @booth-w and @VXNCXNX.
- Copying a symlink preserves the link, and compressing a dotfile such as `.env` produces `.env.zip`. Thanks @xelavopelk and @toller892.
- If you use **cd on quit**, replace the function in your shell profile and reload it. The updated Bash, zsh, fish, and PowerShell functions ask `spf` where it writes the last directory. Thanks @VXNCXNX. [Shell setup](https://superfile.dev/configure/superfile-config/#cd_on_quit)
- Try the two new Rosé Pine themes by setting `theme` to `rose-pine-dawn` or `rose-pine-moon`. Thanks @MJLiiii.

<details><summary>Theme screenshots</summary>

![Rosé Pine Dawn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yorukot/superfile/b9b49bff9d5d6fff188c51713d3bf7d08c85289c/website/src/assets/theme/rose-pine-dawn.png)

![Rosé Pine Moon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yorukot/superfile/b9b49bff9d5d6fff188c51713d3bf7d08c85289c/website/src/assets/theme/rose-pine-moon.png)

</details>

## Detailed Change Summary

<details><summary>Details</summary>

#### Update

- Use the native Trash on macOS, the Recycle Bin on Windows, and the FreeDesktop trash on Linux by @yorukot in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1495
- Write all selected paths to the chooser file in panel order by @Abhirup0 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1653
- Show the number of items in a folder in the file panel’s size column by @booth-w in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1648
- Show Windows file attributes in the metadata panel by @xelavopelk in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1464
- Show FreeBSD file flags in the metadata panel by @clausecker in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1472
- Recognize the FreeBSD `NO_UCACHE` flag by @clausecker in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1644
- Add the Rosé Pine Dawn and Rosé Pine Moon themes by @MJLiiii in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1664
- Add an uninstall script for Linux and macOS by @dragosgatan in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1467
- Add an application icon and AppStream metadata for the desktop entry by @Jaredy899 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1523
- Report permission errors when compressing files by @xelavopelk in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1498

#### Bug Fix

- Handle trash on Linux filesystems mounted outside the root partition by @paczek654321 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1490
- Preserve symbolic links when copying files by @xelavopelk in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1501
- Copy the paths of all selected items to the system clipboard by @yorukot in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1486
- Keep the leading dot when naming archives for hidden files and folders by @xelavopelk in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1475
- Preserve dotfile names when removing an extension would leave an empty or dot-only ZIP name by @toller892 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1485
- Keep dotted parent directory names intact when choosing where to extract an archive by @xelavopelk in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1476
- Show the underlying error when creating a file or directory fails by @xelavopelk in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1524
- Apply create, paste, compress, and extract shortcuts only when a file panel has focus by @somaz94 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1685
- Stop Page Up and Page Down at the first and last items by @KristianHolme in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1504
- Scroll the focused panel with Page Up and Page Down by @prajwalmahajan101 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1519
- Keep keyboard focus on a newly opened file panel by @prajwalmahajan101 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1518
- Respect the configured sidebar sections and their order by @nenas1ya in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1442
- Keep the icon out of the name when renaming a pinned directory by @ikan31 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1540
- Skip fuzzy search when filtering leaves no candidate filenames by @lazysegtree in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1609
- Recognize printable UTF-8 text in file previews by @KristianHolme in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1507
- Expand tabs to the next tab stop in text previews by @prajwalmahajan101 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1509
- Show a focus prompt for folder size until the metadata panel calculates it by @VXNCXNX in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1630
- Handle unreadable entries while calculating directory size by @YuriNachos in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1627
- Handle empty input in the superfile prompt by @MouadHaikal in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1701
- Expand a leading tilde only when it stands alone or precedes a path separator by @Abhirup0 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1652
- Remove stale trailing bytes when repairing a TOML file by @ikan31 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1529
- Have the cd-on-quit shell functions ask the installed binary for the lastdir path by @VXNCXNX in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1629
- Use Go 1.26 for the Nix package to fix builds on Apple Silicon by @MachXNU in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1635

#### Optimization

- Check the file signature before attempting to read its binary architecture by @earfman in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1552
- Skip mount scans when the sidebar’s disks section is hidden by @SriVishnu230707 in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1674
- Split keyboard handling by panel focus and selection mode by @yorukot in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1487

#### Documentation

- Redesign the website and add a version switcher for the documentation by @yorukot in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1729
- Document AI contributions and publish the security policy on the website by @yorukot in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1735
- Document directory icons and plugin configuration by @yorukot in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1491
- Render GitHub-flavored Markdown tables on MDX pages by @KristianHolme in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1503

- Update font troubleshooting instructions by @matsuyamaru in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1603
- Document what happens to the config folder when uninstalling by @costajohnt in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1684
- Add community videos to the website by @yorukot in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1543
- Correct typos in the documentation by @KristianHolme in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1505
- Correct the author credit for the 0x96f theme by @0x96f in https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1641
